_meta: G7.1 J10 GAS71 (docs/G71_SCOPE.md J10, roster Q7 PROVISIONAL): counter-nanite gas, masks, filters. Read by sim/systems/gas71.gd. Every number PROVISIONAL (CNOPS71 picked it; the scope leaves it open). conc 1000 = a fresh full-strength cloud; cell = tiles per gas cell; every / wind_every in ticks; *_pm = per mille per update.

_notes.machine_dps: hp/s at conc 1000 (a 1000-hp walker dies in ~17 s in a fresh cloud)
_notes.human_dps: hp/s at conc 1000 for an unmasked soldier
_notes.filter_wear: filter per-mille lost per s at conc 1000, scaled by conc (a fresh filter lasts ~28 s in a full cloud, minutes at the edges)
_notes.default_mask: standard issue: every LP soldier carries one mask; lockers / armory / gate crates replace masks and filters, bearers carry spares
